reviews.text:
I LOVE THIS PLACE. There is not enough good things I can say about the Den. I've been coming here for a year and a half now. This place has taken care of my dog like no other. Julia gives the best advice for my Stanley and catches things I would have not noticed. I've recommended the Den to all owners and they've had nothing but good things to say as well, regardless of breed.

Stanley is a wire haired corgi and his haircuts in the past have not been great. I've never received so many compliments on my dog's coat and how good he looks. Lastly, THE PRICE. The Den is priced very reasonably. Even with a tip every visit it is way better priced than base pricing at all the groomers I've been to.

I’ve been bringing Frank to The Den Spa for a year now, and we couldn’t be happier! Julia is the absolute best. She’s so caring, attentive, and always makes sure Frank is well taken care of. Highly recommend The Den Spa!

I have been bringing my little monster to Julia for about 2 years and have nothing but great experiences to share!

Her shop is immaculate! Very clean and well kept inside. I love the one on one attention, my pup receives. My pug absolutely loves Julia and genuinely enjoys visits with her! She may be his favorite person and while that hurts my feelings it makes me feel all the better knowing how well she treats him. She is familiar with his allergies and medications, and pays close attention to him when she is grooming. So much so, that she will alert me when she notices something starting to flare up. She is professional and respectful of all the little doggos that come in and out of her shop. I wholly trust her with my little guy, and have entrusted her with pet sitting on 2 separate occasions (the last being a month long stay).

I have only good things to say about Julia and The Den and recommend her shop to all pet parents!

I have been taking my dog to Julia for about 2 years and it's the best grooming experience I (and my dog Tor) have had! They do amazing work and are so good with all fur babies. My doggo is a malamute/samoyed mix, so lots of maintenance and LOTS of hair. Julia makes him look beautiful consistently and he's always so happy to go visit them. We also take our cat to get her nails trimmed here since our experience with Julia's grooming was top tier. Excellent communication and the booking portal is super easy to navigate. Love the shop, the team and highly recommend The Den Paw Spa to everyone!

I really didn't want to leave a bad review about this place, but unfortunately, I feel like I have to. We brought our 5 month old puppy in for a maintenance trim. We specifically asked for his nails to be trimmed, the hair around his eyes to be cleaned up so he could see, and just a small trim overall. We did not want him to receive a full haircut because he is still a puppy.

When we dropped him off, the worker was not very welcoming and basically told us to just drop him off and pick him up at 5:30. When we returned, we were very disappointed to see that our puppy had received a full haircut. I asked why his hair had been cut so short, and she explained that his hair was matted (which was not )and that his coat was currently transitioning, so it would grow back better this way. However, we never gave permission for a full haircut, and I feel we should have been contacted beforehand if they felt a more extensive cut was necessary.

Unfortunately, that wasn't even the only issue. Our puppy was also nicked/scraped around his private area during the grooming. Afterward, he was walking strangely and constantly scratching his bottom, which became concerning enough that we had to take him to the emergency vet.

We are extremely disappointed with this experience. If a groomer feels that a full haircut is necessary, they should communicate that with the owner and get approval before proceeding. We trusted them with our 5-month-old puppy, and unfortunately, we left feeling that our concerns and instructions were not respected.

I would not recommend this place based on our experience.

We bring all 3 of our dogs here and the place is great. They always do an amazing job and our puppers get pretty relaxed with everyone there.

I can't recommend it more.

I can’t say enough good things about Melanie at The Den Paw Spa. Trusting someone with my dog is a big deal, and from the very first visit she made me feel completely at ease. You can tell right away how much she genuinely cares about the dogs she works with.

My pup came back looking amazing — clean, soft, perfectly groomed, and honestly happier than when I dropped her off. Melanie has such a calm, kind energy, and my dog took to her immediately, which says a lot.

It’s rare to find someone who treats your dog like their own, but that’s exactly how Melanie is. If you’re looking for a groomer who is sweet, patient, talented, and truly loves what she does, she’s the one. The Den Paw Spa is lucky to have her, and my dogs and I are definitely loyal customers now.

Absolutely fabulous! We just moved downtown, & needed a great groomer. It’s a relaxed shop where the ladies love the dogs and making them extra soft!! Onyx & Indigo love The Den their new spa! Affordable, easy parking & my pups are super happy! Tysm!! ❤️

I’ve tried a few groomers in the area but Julia is by far the best I’ve found in SD. She’s awesome with my dog and it’s obvious she cares about both the quality of her work and the overall experience.

The Den is very mellow and my dog has always been in and out within 2 hours, which makes a huge difference. He's always come home relaxed and like he's never left, and that alone is why I keep going back.

I was walking my Shih Tzu in Balboa Park one day and ran into an impeccably groomed cavapoo.  I asked the owner who groomed her fur child and she raved about this place. I booked an appointment and have been coming every couple of months for almost a year now.
My dog ALWAYS comes home looking and smelling wonderful…but best of all he is always super happy after his grooming!
Try it, you’ll like it!
Every time we have our pup groomed here he looks and smells fantastic!! They run a great establishment.

Julia and her team are professional, kind, and trustworthy. They go above and beyond to ensure that my kitten and I are comfortable, regardless of the service provided. It is such a gift to know that I have a dependable team to support the best care for my fur baby.

Lilly was the absolute best I will totally recommend her she took care of my grandparents schnauzer we used to take her to Petco but not anymore we will be coming to Lilly from now on look no further she will care for your dog like her own 🫶🏼

This dog grooming place is such a breathe of fresh air (it’s also stunning)! I’ve found my new favorite groomer Lily! She took care of my dog like her own. I would definitely recommend this place and I will be returning to Lily! 🖤 …

I took my Maltipoo, Slater, to The Den to see Lily and she was amazing! My sweet boy came back looking so cute and fluffy. Lily was very sweet with him and you can tell she really loves the dogs she works with. Definitely going back to her again!!

Julia is the best! I have been taking my cockapoo, Kennedy, to her for over four years now.  Even weeks after she is groomed, people stop me to compliment her cut and remark that it looks like she was just groomed.

Kennedy was attacked when she was little, so she can be trepidatious and feisty around unfamiliar dogs, but Julia has always handled her with aplomb. Additionally, she is always very thorough and discovered that my pup needed some teeth removed. You can rest assured that your dog is in great hands.

Lastly, Julia is a great listener and always grooms Kennedy to my specifications. Truly, we would be lost without her!
Julia is the absolute best groomer in Southern California!! I can’t recommend her enough.

Look no further, The Den Paw Spa is the BEST! Julia, thank you so much for your patience and for taking care of my Mason. He was quite shaggy when I dropped him off and now he looks like a new boy! My dog is a rescue and I'm usually pretty nervous about leaving him in others' care, but Julia is such a professional and provides excellent service - truly the best groomer. We'll see you guys soon!

I can’t even say enough amazing things about Julia and her ship. Emily did my pups hair for a long time and recently left. Julia had always stepped in when she was gone but has now become our girl! She takes the time to work with my anxious, strong personality, senior pup and it takes all the anxiety away from bringing him to the groomer. She is calm, relaxed, and the alpha for sure! And my pup has never looked better. I’ll never stray from her 💯 I’d recommend to every single person I know! The best 🙏🏼

Super awesome grooming service. We have taken our dog Benji here multiple times since moving to San Diego and she’s quick, easy to book with, and our dog always looks beautifully groomed. Highly recommend.

I want to edit this really quick to add something because I just read a one star review that someone left about her communication… And I totally disagree. She runs this business by herself, which is unbelievable and she has always responded to our text messages every single time I’ve reached out. Whoever left that review is clearly impatient. She’s great, bottom line

We love coming to The Den for our fur baby’s grooming needs. As an owner of a pup who doesn’t particularly enjoy baths, all the staff here makes it so he always leaves with a big smile! I confidently trust that he is in great hands whenever he comes here. Thank you for always going above and beyond for our pup, The Den!
The Den paw spa is the BEST place that we have brought our golden doodle to! Easy scheduling, great service and a comfortable environment for our pup.

I can’t say enough great things about The Den Paw Spa and the incredible care that Julia provides. My 15-year-old Lab mix, Jake, has been going to Julia for his grooming needs, and she treats him like her own. At his age, with weakened hips and mobility issues, Jake needs a little extra time and support during baths—and Julia never hesitates to give him the care and attention he deserves.

Every visit, she’s patient, gentle, and incredibly compassionate. Jake always leaves clean, calm, and happy, which says a lot for a senior dog who can be sensitive to handling. The spa is clean, well-organized, and has a calming vibe that puts both pets and owners at ease.

Julia clearly has a deep love for animals and takes pride in her work. You can tell she goes above and beyond—not just with the grooming itself, but in making the whole experience stress-free. I trust her completely with Jake, and that kind of peace of mind is priceless.

If you’re looking for a groomer who truly understands and cares about your pet, The Den Paw Spa is the place to go. Thank you, Julia, for always taking such amazing care of Jake!
Took good care of my dog

I can’t say enough great things about Julia! She is hands down the best dog groomer we've ever had. From the moment we met her, it was clear she genuinely loves animals and treats each dog like her own. Our pup used to get anxious before grooming appointments, but with Julia, he actually wags his tail walking through the door!

She’s incredibly gentle, patient, and meticulous and always makes sure our dog looks amazing without stressing him out. Julia takes the time to listen to what we want, gives helpful advice, and somehow gets the haircut exactly right every single time. She also keeps everything super clean and professional, which gives me peace of mind.

If you're looking for someone who will go above and beyond for your furry friend, Julia is the one. We feel so lucky to have found her. Highly, highly recommend!
Clean and nice the owner Julie is great !

The Den is paws-down the best pet grooming salon in San Diego. Fabulous service, high-quality work, and great technical skills. The personalized care keeps me & my fur babies excited to return always. Highly recommend if you’re seeking a new grooming home. Julia is so knowledgeable & she truly cares.

We've been going to The Den Paw Spa ever since they opened up, and I can honestly say it’s the best dog groomer in San Diego—hands down. After trying just about every groomer in the area over the years, this place stands out by a mile. The staff is friendly, the space is clean and calming, and most importantly, they treat your pup like their own.

We absolutely love Julia—she gives such special care and attention to our little Maltipoo every time. You can tell she really cares and takes pride in what she does. Our dog always comes back happy, clean, and perfectly groomed.

Could not recommend these groomers more. 5/5.
Emily the groomer is great with our Fur baby she is very professional.

My husband brought our Rat Terrier in for a deshedding. We really love this groomer and we are glad we gave them a try. The process is really easy, just fill out an inquiry online with your availability and they will text or call you to schedule an appointment. Love that they take one dog at a time and they aren’t spending time in kennels! Pricing is more than fair! Highly recommend.

Julia does a great job with my cat, Zoey! I have come to her for lion cuts and Zoey feels very comfortable at The Den Paw Spa, so I highly recommend trying them out. It’s hard to find a cat groomer you can trust, and I definitely trust them.

My pup doesn't require a lot of maintenance, so it seemed a little excessive to take him to a dog spa. But I appreciated that The Den charges lower rates for little guys. Julia definitely loves what she does and the place has an awesome neighborhood vibe. So glad they are close by! We will be regulars.

My pup’s first Dog Spa and I couldn’t be more satisfied! I’m so glad he had good first experience. He came back to us nice and clean, no crazy hair coming off anymore, trimmed nails and fashionable bandana with carrots! (He loves them btw). Mr. Pete will be back!

Had an amazing experience here at The Den- tried calling a couple times to schedule a grooming with no answer but promptly received a text back saying they were busy with other dogs but would love to help- easily scheduled a same day spa day for my friends pup and everything was great! Julia the owner was terrific and took the best care of Figgy girl, she was so happy and clean when I picked her up. Thanks again The den- would highly recommend coming here!!
They treated my pup so well here! Fair prices and really great service. My dog came out fresh, clean, and with a cute bandana. Would definitely recommend this spa for your pet!

We've been taking Pax to Julia for over four years, and there’s no one else we’d trust with his grooming. She’s consistently done a fantastic job, and we’re so glad she’s opened her own place.

Julia is professional, detail-oriented, and truly cares about the dogs she works with. Pax always comes back looking great and feeling comfortable. If you’re looking for a groomer who knows what they’re doing and puts the dogs first, Julia is the one to go to. Highly recommend!
Julia is the best! A true lover of animals! She really cares about the comfort of the animals and goes above and beyond to do a great job! I would not bring my big boy other shop. Thank you Julia.

The Den is the only place we bring our 2 year old golden retriever in downtown San Diego! After over a year of disappointing experiences at various places nearby, we are so thrilled to have The Den open. Booking is so easy and Julia is truly one of the best! Our dog loves going to get groomed now and always leaves looking exactly how we want. Knowing that he will never be crated is also such a relief. The drop off/pickup with Fetch is also a dream and so convenient! Cannot recommend them enough!

The Den Paw Spa/Julia is the only place I trust to trim his nails. Other groomers I've gone to in the past hardly cut/shave them down. She is a true pro and does it quickly and shortens them perfectly. I think it's been 3 years now since meeting Julia the first time! Very grateful for her!
Amazing service. So accommodating and kind. Explain everything well and took great care of my dog. Well 100% be my permanent groomer

We are so happy that The Den Paw Spa is in our neighborhood! When we saw them open we immediately booked a grooming appointment for our dog, Pepper. He came out clean and smelling great 🐕 The owner is very friendly. …

Look at this handsome guy!! Julia and The Den provide the best service for your pets grooming needs in the San Diego area. Their attention to detail and genuine love for animals ensure your pet feels pampered! My dogs have been going to her for 7 years including speciality grooms and holiday styling and they always freak out because they are so excited to see her! If you have a furry friend try this place out it’s top notch and a local business :)

From the moment you walk in, you’re going to know you picked the right groomer. Julia is super welcoming and professional, and she takes the time to make sure the grooming experience is stress free for everyone. The place is new and has a clean and calm atmosphere. I highly recommend Julia to anyone looking for experience backed and genuinely caring grooming services. I’m really happy to be supporting a female-owned, small business to boot.
Number listed on the website does not respond to availability inquiries as communicated on the website. Such a shame, as this place is very close to our apartment.
Julia is the best! We have followed her a few places and she has now opened the Den which is so convenient! I especially have to show off how handsome she made Fernando and Alfredo for our wedding!
Savvy’s one and only groomer. Transforming her from street rat, to living teddy bear! Doodle expert!
